operation.source_intent: When the requested MediaManager site cannot be resolved, expose a read-only Back to sites recovery action.

authoritative_not_found: 404 from GET /tenants/{tenant}/context?site={site} while entering the Media workspace
404 from the canonical /tenants/{tenant}/sites/{site}/media route before redirect when the site is missing or foreign
laravel_adaptation.availability: The action renders only for ApiError status 404 in Media context; successful reads and non-404 failures never render it. The collection API is not treated as the authority for site existence.

security.source_route_guard: auth + tenant.context + content.view with tenant-scoped Site lookup
security.tenant_source: tenant slug from the already tenant-qualified Media bootstrap or authenticated FrontendContext

authoritative_state.source: canonical tenant/site Media bootstrap and site-bound route; the Media collection read remains a tenant-scoped content read
authoritative_state.direct_missing_site: canonical context and site-bound Media route preserve the existing fail-closed 404/IDOR behavior
authoritative_state.successful_media_state: does not render the recovery action
authoritative_state.generic_failure: does not render the recovery action
authoritative_state.media_collection_missing_site: not used as site-existence proof; current collection semantics may return an empty 200

coverage: 500 does not manufacture the source action
missing site context and foreign direct site route remain 404
